name: Burning Body
s: A crime out of the ordinary. A tangle of affairs built on lies and desire. A shocking story based on true events within Barcelona's police forces.

paragraphs.text: Burning Body () is a 2023 Spanish crime television miniseries written by Laura Sarmiento and directed by and Laura Mañá. It stars Úrsula Corberó, Quim Gutiérrez, and José Manuel Poga.
